classification_reason: All 20 canon probes recorded with product-grounded candidates, but `related` returns only linked concepts/sources (not ranked note candidates), so every probe needed manual search triangulation.

commands: los note-read <query note> x20 (full reads; C16/C17 re-used S02 reads + related re-run)

los search <single-term> x~30 (Bayes, ridge, likelihood, scheduling, optimizer, tessera, svd, pipeline, inference, serving, cache, kernel, normalization, acid, lru, softmax, compiler, hypothesis, momentum, adam, ...)
los search <term> --content x~12 (spam, prior, parallel, speedup, logging, recovery, system call, functional, cards, habit, hypothesis)

los note-read <candidate> x~12 (generative-vs-discriminative, conditional-probability, amdahl, journaling, caching-everywhere, page-replacement, cap-consistency, first-take, adam-always-better, pomodoro, ...)
confusions: `related` returns the note's own linked concepts/sources, not 'what to read next' — resolved by triangulating with single-term search + reading.
Multi-term search behaves as AND (e.g. 'Bayes posterior classification' returns nothing) — resolved by single-term queries.
note-read pagination needs --expected-snapshot from the prior response; re-reading fully was simpler.
corrective_steps: Per-probe routine: full query-note read + related + 1-3 single-term searches (+ content search where snippets helped) + bounded reads of top candidates; recorded best-first with reasons and quotes.
consumer.first_action: Reset the world to fresh, then trialled `los related` on one note to see what the connection command returns.
consumer.goal: For each of 20 canon probes, show what else to read next to it, best first, with reasons.
consumer.outcome: 20 connection records (C01-C20, phase canon) in connections.jsonl: 2-5 targets each, ranked, with reasons, evidence quotes, product-vs-reading sources, and contrast/superseded/outdated flags where apt. No world changes.

friction.description: `related` answers 'what is this linked to' (concepts/sources), not 'what should I read next'; there is no ranked related-notes command, so each probe needs manual search triangulation and candidate reads.
Multi-word search silently returns [] under AND semantics with no hint to split terms; single-term behavior had to be discovered by probing.
note-read --offset without --expected-snapshot fails; the pagination contract is only visible after a first full read.

internal.derived_changes: None (search caches already built in S02).

scenario_record.product_vs_reading: Most candidates product-surfaced via search/related; agent-reading used for: C04 stage (study-map), C07 selinger+NB cross-links (content parallel), C11 VM note + round-robin, C19 NB log-space parallel.
